#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

using namespace std;

class InputReader {
private:
    FILE *stream;
    char buf[1024];
    int curChar;
    int numChars;

public:
    InputReader(FILE *stream) {
        this->stream = stream;
    }

    int read() {
        if (numChars == -1)
            throw runtime_error("Unknown error");
        if (curChar >= numChars) {
            curChar = 0;
            numChars = fread(buf, 1, 1024, stream);
            if (numChars <= 0)
                return -1;
        }
        return buf[curChar++];
    }

    int peek() {
        if (numChars == -1)
            return -1;
        if (curChar >= numChars) {
            curChar = 0;
            numChars = fread(buf, 1, 1024, stream);
            if (numChars <= 0)
                return -1;
        }
        return buf[curChar];
    }

    void skip(int x) {
        while (x-- > 0)
            read();
    }

    int nextInt() {
        int c = read();
        while (isSpaceChar(c))
            c = read();
        int res = 0;
        do {
            res = res * 10 + c - '0';
            c = read();
        } while (!isSpaceChar(c));
        return res;
    }

    long nextLong() {
        int c = read();
        while (isSpaceChar(c))
            c = read();
        long res = 0;
        do {
            res = res * 10 + c - '0';
            c = read();
        } while (!isSpaceChar(c));
        return res;
    }

    string nextString() {
        int c = read();
        while (isSpaceChar(c))
            c = read();
        stringstream ss;
        do {
            ss << c;
            c = read();
        } while (!isSpaceChar(c));
        return ss.str();
    }

    string nextLine() {
        stringstream ss;
        int c = read();
        while (c != '\n' && c != -1) {
            if (c != '\r')
                ss << c;
            c = read();
        }
        return ss.str();
    }

    double nextDouble() {
        int c = read();
        while (isSpaceChar(c))
            c = read();
        int sgn = 1;
        if (c == '-') {
            sgn = -1;
            c = read();
        }
        double res = 0;
        while (!isSpaceChar(c) && c != '.') {
            if (c == 'e' || c == 'E')
                return res * pow(10, nextInt());
            if (c < '0' || c > '9')
                throw runtime_error("Input mismatch exception");
            res = res * 10 + c - '0';
            c = read();
        }
        if (c == '.') {
            c = read();
            double m = 1;
            while (!isSpaceChar(c)) {
                if (c == 'e' || c == 'E')
                    return res * pow(10, nextInt());
                if (c < '0' || c > '9')
                    throw runtime_error("Input mismatch exception");
                m /= 10;
                res = res + (c - '0') * m;
                c = read();
            }
        }
        return res * sgn;
    }

    bool hasNext() {
        int value;
        while (isSpaceChar(value = peek()) && value != -1)
            read();
        return value != -1;
    }

private:
    bool isSpaceChar(int c) {
        return c == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\t' || c == -1;
    }
};

int main() {
    InputReader in(stdin);
    string str;
    int n = in.nextInt();
    int b = in.nextInt();
    vector<int> arr1(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        arr1[i] = in.nextInt();
    int odd = 0, even = 0;
    vector<int> pf1(n), pf2(n);
    int sum1 = 0, sum2 = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (arr1[i] % 2 == 0)
            sum1++;
        else
            sum2++;
        pf1[i] = sum1;
        pf2[i] = sum2;
    }
    int prev = 0;
    vector<int> arr(n);
    int p = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i < n - 2; i += 2) {
        int x, y;
        if (prev == 0) {
            x = pf1[i];
            y = pf2[i];
        }
        else {
            x = pf1[i] - pf1[prev];
            y = pf2[i] - pf2[prev];
        }
        if (x == y) {
            arr[p] = abs(arr1[i + 1] - arr1[i]);
            p++;
        }
    }
    vector<int> val(p);
    for (int i = 0; i < p; i++)
        val[i] = 1;
    vector<vector<int>> K(p + 1, vector<int>(b + 1));
    for (int i = 0; i <= p; i++) {
        for (int w = 0; w <= b; w++) {
            if (i == 0 || w == 0)
                K[i][w] = 0;
            else if (arr[i - 1] <= w)
                K[i][w] = max(val[i - 1] + K[i - 1][w - arr[i - 1]], K[i - 1][w]);
            else
                K[i][w] = K[i - 1][w];
        }
    }
    cout << K[p][b] << endl;
    return 0;
}
